rationale: The expression is internally consistent and correctly cumulates both legs over three years, but it is a horizon/smoothing parameter tweak of the already-evaluated champion (Off Books Share Of Capital Formation) rather than a substantively different mechanism, and its main promised payoff (turnover/persistence) is a portfolio-implementation diagnostic rather than new economic content.

This is a genuinely different construction — it replaces the level-profitability/cash validator with a multi-year asset-turnover trend, so it is neither a rediscovery of a single archive signal nor mechanically collinear with RMW, it broadens coverage relative to the cash-validated champion, and the expression's natural direction matches the stated positive sign.

target_name: Non Capitalization With Restored Cash Power
rationale: This is a one-leg swap on the already-evaluated Cash Validated Intangible Write Down, and the stated purpose (purging spending intensity so the accounting choice can be isolated) is not actually achieved because xrd+xad is added back into the cash leg, so the intensity tilt persists and the intended decomposition is not clean.

target_name: Cash Return On Hidden Knowledge Stock
rationale: This is effectively a rediscovery of the archive's Self Funded Innovation Program — the same MIN(cash-to-cumulative-intangible-spend, intangible intensity) structure with only the cash numerator changed from a five-year sum to a single year — so it offers little independent information beyond an already-tested signal.

The sign logic is internally coherent, but the construction is largely the mechanical mirror of the champion's short leg and its two ingredients (low cash profitability, high capitalized-investment share) are close proxies for the well-documented profitability and investment/asset-growth anomalies that FF5 already spans, so a "live short leg" result would be hard to attribute to hidden-capital mispricing.

Gating the champion's composition ratio on genuine intangible spending is a well-motivated precision repair with a falsifiable prediction about the amortisation-run-off contaminated group, though it remains close to the champion and will cut coverage further, so any improvement must be judged against sparser sampling.
